summary: The committed benchmark artifacts pass the schema, canonical-ID/span, split, leakage-boundary, hash-pinning, test, and protected-file checks. The no_selection conclusion is supported by the committed evidence, and GPU_BLOCKED is supported in this environment. Release approval is blocked because the holdout-consumption guard can be bypassed by directing a run outside reports/benchmark, and because diagnostic run reports persist a variant label where they claim to persist the actual graph configuration.

findings.title: Holdout consumption is not enforced for an arbitrary output root
evidence: benchmarks/kingscode_ir/manifests/holdout_access.json predeclares only R0/holdout/predeclared_baseline and binds it to manifest SHA-256 326a405748dd20f641d5cf4103ceaafb6a19f07b43db54d95f472a2b439e3071.
kingscode/retrieval_benchmark.py::_holdout_was_consumed searches only ROOT/reports/benchmark for a prior matching report.
kingscode/retrieval_benchmark.py::run accepts output_root, and tools/evaluate_retrieval_benchmark.py exposes it as --output-root without restricting it to ROOT/reports/benchmark.

A holdout run written to another path is therefore absent from the only consumption scan; a subsequent matching run can be authorized again. The current committed final artifact has exactly one matching passed R0 holdout report, but that fact does not close the future bypass.
findings.required_action: Bind holdout consumption to a durable, repository-controlled ledger or forbid external output roots for holdout runs. Atomically record/consume the declaration before retrieval, and add tests showing a first holdout run at a custom output root blocks a second run.

findings.checklist_area: R0-R8 variable isolation, diagnostic labeling, and reproducibility
findings.title: Diagnostic reports record a variant name instead of the executed configuration
evidence: kingscode/retrieval_benchmark.py::_run_one executes R0-GRAPH-AUTO-DIAGNOSTIC with graph mode auto and R0-GRAPH-ON-DIAGNOSTIC with graph mode on, but run() writes config.graph_mode as the full variant string for every non-R0 variant.

The committed final diagnostic reports, for example reports/benchmark/r0_graph_auto_diagnostic/20260928T182523452046Z-dev/report.json, contain graph_mode=R0-GRAPH-AUTO-DIAGNOSTIC rather than auto; analogous R6/R7/R8 reports do not serialize their effective experiment parameters in the top-level configuration.
The diagnostic suffixes and selection exclusion are correctly labelled, but the persisted configuration is not an exact execution record.
findings.required_action: Serialize actual retrieval mode, graph mode, reranker/model identity, candidate limits, and each diagnostic experiment's effective parameters separately from the human-facing variant label. Add report-schema assertions for R0 graph diagnostics and R6-R8 diagnostics.

checklist.evidence: questions contain no forbidden gold/evaluation fields (independent scan: 0); retrieval_input accepts only question text; build/check returned question_gold_separated=true; static protected-data scan found only policy/tests/forbidden-field references, not reads of sample_50, legal_basis, answers, or generation targets.

benchmark_manifest.json records generation.closed_model_used=false and deterministic_template_over_verified_corpus_metadata; benchmark_builder.py constructs locator templates and contains no model/network invocation; semantic/temporal candidates are kept in a human-review queue. This verifies the committed implementation and artifact provenance claims, not unrecorded activity outside the repository.

tools/build_retrieval_benchmark.py --check returned gold_ids_resolved=true for all 200 cases. The verifier resolves canonical document/fragment IDs and confirms each span's passage, fragment, and [clean_start, clean_end) containment against corpus/passages.jsonl.

Independent JSONL audit found dev/validation/holdout counts 120/40/40 for both questions and gold; question/gold ID sets match per split; all pairwise split intersections are zero; manifest hashes match schema and every question/gold split.
Independent audit found 0 duplicate question texts, 0 duplicate gold evidence fragment IDs across all 200 cases, 0 duplicate gold spans, and 0 ID overlap between splits.

The declaration is manifest-bound and predeclares R0 only. There is exactly one matching final passed holdout report, reports/benchmark/r0/20260928T182502854311Z-holdout/report.json, with variant R0 and holdout_purpose predeclared_baseline. The arbitrary-output-root bypass prevents approval of the consumption control.

The diff changes neither data/sample_50.jsonl nor official starter files. reports/benchmark/official50_confirmation/status.json defers confirmation; its historical reference is explicitly marked not used for internal tuning.

experiment_matrix.json documents isolated R0-R5 definitions and R6-R8 as R3-based ablations; CPU runs are suffixed DIAGNOSTIC and selected_config.json explicitly excludes them from selection. The report configuration defect prevents complete reproducibility/audit of what the diagnostics executed.

Metric tests cover multi-evidence, empty results, context cost, complementarity, equal-ID constraints, and deterministic paired bootstrap. paired_bootstrap uses seed 0 and 10,000 resamples; stored source/corpus/manifest identities reference existing ancestors of HEAD. Exact diagnostic runtime configuration is nevertheless not faithfully serialized.

benchmark_manifest.json pins passages, graph nodes/edges, BM25, schema, and split hashes. Both verify() and run() recompute and fail closed; --check passed with manifest SHA-256 326a405748dd20f641d5cf4103ceaafb6a19f07b43db54d95f472a2b439e3071.

checklist.area: Member B and official files unchanged
checklist.evidence: git diff --name-only 6f9b040 89cb59d has no paths in Member B code/config/reports and no paths in data/sample_50.jsonl, schema/, Ejemplo de entrega/, docs/OFFICIAL_SHA256.txt, or the other identified official starter-pack paths.

.venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/build_retrieval_benchmark.py --check passed; focused tests ran 17 tests successfully; .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m unittest discover -s tests -p test*.py ran 149 tests successfully.

no_selection.evidence: selected_config.json has status no_selection and only R0 as an eligible validation result. Its five stored R0 validation metrics exactly match reports/benchmark/r0/20260928T182455334014Z-validation/report.json. Final-manifest reports for R1-BGE, R1-QWEN, R2-BGE, R2-QWEN, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7, and R8 are GPU_BLOCKED; CPU graph/metadata results retain DIAGNOSTIC names and are excluded from selection.

gpu_blocked.evidence: The venv reports torch 2.12.0+cpu, cuda_available=false, cuda_device_count=0; nvidia-smi is unavailable; corpus/index/dense.npy is absent. GPU_BLOCKED reports claim no metrics and list prerequisites rather than fabricating results. This support is specific to the audited local environment and does not establish the status of another machine.

non_blocking_observations.title: Patch whitespace check reports CRLF lines as trailing whitespace
non_blocking_observations.evidence: git diff --check 6f9b040 89cb59d emits warnings for CRLF-added lines. .gitattributes sets * -text to preserve exact source bytes, so this is a patch-hygiene observation rather than a benchmark-data integrity finding.
